character_sheet: A towering armoured enderman: a pelvis, three spine pieces and four ribs up to a neck, collars and shoulders, a head, two three-piece arms - the right one holding a sword of handle and blade - two legs of thigh, two shin pieces and a hip, four foot pieces each, and a two-piece cape (ModelEnderKnight.java:64-103; 40 parts on a 512x512 sheet; 2.9 blocks tall). It is a hostile enderman in mail: 60 HP, 12 damage, 6 armour, speed 0.32, a 64-block follow range (MobStats.ENDER_KNIGHT, EnderKnight.java:202-210). It attacks a player who looks at it - the nearest player within 64 blocks whose gaze lines up with its chest and who has no pumpkin on (:90-144, :187-200), the enderman stare rule - or whoever hurts it (:63-74), closing with a vanilla melee goal (:56). While it has a target it SCREAMS (a synched flag, :40-41, :119, :342) and teleports: away when the starer comes within 4 blocks, toward a target more than 16 blocks away (:264-286), at random when hit by an arrow or magic (:339-349), in daylight (:243-255) and when wet or burning (:257-262, :228-230); portal particles stream off it (:232-241). It spawns in darkness at night above y 30 (:366-374). Read it as an enderman knight: a long-legged stride, the cape stirring, arms folded and the sword low at rest - then, screaming, the arms thrown up and the sword whirling.
size_notes: Drawn at x1.0 of the rig (EnderKnightRenderer.java:25; no scale override) on a 512x512 sheet (ModelEnderKnight.java:270); the hitbox is 0.6 x 2.9 (ModEntities.java:87-89); shadow 0.3 (EnderKnightRenderer.java:27).

groups.name: gait
groups.amplitude: rests 0 (thigh, foot pieces 1, 3, 4), -0.1 rad (shin pieces), +0.6 (foot piece 2), then pi x 0.25 = 0.785 rad (45 deg) x the walking speed at 1.3 x 0.21 - still below the 0.1 threshold; the cape's lower piece rolls by a quarter of it
groups.plain: the long legs stride in opposition, every piece of a leg together, and the cape swings a little with the step
groups.math: a = limbSwingAmount > 0.1 ? cos(ageInTicks * 1.3 * 0.21) * pi * 0.25 * limbSwingAmount : 0; lfoot1/3/4.xRot = a; lfoot2.xRot = 0.6 + a; lleg1.xRot = a; lleg2/lleg3.xRot = -0.1 + a; the right pieces the same rests - a; cape2.zRot = a / 4
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.3 x 0.21 (wingspeed, ModelEnderKnight.java:21): the natural period is 2 pi / 0.273 = 23 ticks

groups.name: cape_sway
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.02 = 0.063 rad (3.6 deg), at all times
groups.plain: the cape's lower piece stirs slowly fore and aft
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.7 x 0.21: the natural period is 2 pi / 0.147 = 42.7 ticks

groups.name: arms
groups.amplitude: screaming: -1.2 rad rest (upper arms), -1.8 (forearms), +0.5 (sword), then pi x 0.3 = 0.942 rad (54 deg) on the arms and 1.5 x that (81 deg) on the sword; calm: held still - upper arms -0.5, forearms -1.0 with the left yawed +1.0 and the right -1.0 (folded across), the sword at 0.35; each forearm placed 10 units along its upper arm's pitch, the sword 7 units along the right forearm's
groups.plain: at rest the arms are folded across the chest with the sword held low; screaming, both arms rise high and pump together with the sword whirling wider still
groups.math: s = cos(ageInTicks * 2.7 * 0.21) * pi * 0.3; screaming: larm2/larm3/rarm2/rarm3.xRot = -1.2 + s; larm1/rarm1.xRot = -1.8 + s; handle/blade.xRot = 0.5 + s * 1.5; calm: larm2/larm3/rarm2/rarm3.xRot = -0.5; larm1.xRot = rarm1.xRot = -1.0, larm1.yRot = 1.0, rarm1.yRot = -1.0; handle/blade.xRot = 0.35; larm1/rarm1 y/z placed 10 units along larm2/rarm2's pitch; handle/blade placed 7 units along rarm1's pitch (+1 on y)
groups.phase: the synched screaming flag selects the branch (EnderKnight.java:40-41: set when a player stares, :119, or when hurt, :342; cleared when the target is lost, :124, :283, in daylight, :252, and when wet or burning, :260)
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 2.7 x 0.21: the natural period is 2 pi / 0.567 = 11.1 ticks

behaviour: One gait rhythm on the legs (ModelEnderKnight.java:276-291): above a walking speed of 0.1 the cosine of the age x 1.3 x 0.21 (wingspeed, :21), x pi x 0.25, x the walking speed is added to every piece of the left leg (thigh, two shin pieces around -0.1 rad, four foot pieces, the second around +0.6) and subtracted from the right - a 45-degree stride at full speed every 23 ticks, each leg one rigid unit; the cape's lower piece rolls by a quarter of it. Below the threshold the legs snap to their rests.
The cape's lower piece also stirs at all times (:292): the cosine of the age x 0.7 x 0.21, x pi x 0.02 - 3.6 degrees every 42.7 ticks; the upper piece is static.
The head turns 0.45 of the look yaw, clamped to +-0.45 rad (:293-299), no pitch.

The arms and sword branch on the synched screaming flag (:300-322). Calm: the upper arms at -0.5 rad, the forearms at -1.0 and yawed +1.0 (left) and -1.0 (right) - folded across the chest - the sword handle and blade at 0.35; nothing moves. Screaming: the cosine of the age x 2.7 x 0.21, x pi x 0.3 (54 degrees every 11.1 ticks) is added to -1.2 on the four upper-arm pieces and to -1.8 on the forearms, both arms together, and one and a half times it to 0.5 on the sword - the arms thrown high and pumping, the sword whirling 81 degrees. Each forearm is placed 10 units along its upper arm's pitch and the sword 7 units along the right forearm's (:323-328): a hand-written FK chain on flat bones (when the rig lands a keyframed swing must key the positions too, or the arms must be parented).

The pelvis, spine, ribs, neck, collars, shoulders, hips and upper cape never move. The screaming flag is a held state (EnderKnight.java:119 on a stare, :342 on a hit; cleared at :124, :252, :260, :283) under a name the generator's inventory does not read as an attacking flag (an owner note); the strike is vanilla's MeleeAttackGoal (:56), whose doHurtTarget call is in vanilla code, so the inventory finds no melee site either - the attack is real.
The teleports (EnderKnight.java:290-337) are instant position changes with portal particles and the enderman teleport sound at both ends; the body itself does not animate them.
